concepts.name: 우리의 문장
concepts.motif: An ivory quill with emerald enamel feather veins, a small gold ink vessel and a sculpted ivory scroll.
concepts.progression: 50: one simple quill. 100: a quill with a small ink vessel. 1,000: the quill above one broad ivory scroll. 10,000: a mature quill-and-scroll archive with two layered scrolls and a small gold seal. No lettering on scrolls.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create ONE landscape comparison sheet about 2.4:1 aspect ratio showing EXACTLY FOUR premium physical clan enamel pins in one evenly spaced horizontal row, left to right 50, 100, 1,000, 10,000 milestones.
Family: 우리의 문장. Outer contour shared across all four: an elegant arched writing crest. Motif: An ivory quill with emerald enamel feather veins, a small gold ink vessel and a sculpted ivory scroll.
Specific growth progression, left to right: 50: one simple quill. 100: a quill with a small ink vessel. 1,000: the quill above one broad ivory scroll. 10,000: a mature quill-and-scroll archive with two layered scrolls and a small gold seal. No lettering on scrolls.
Materials: rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory HARD ENAMEL, substantial polished WARM GOLD metal rim and seams, realistic jewelry relief, crisp dimensional bevels and controlled highlights. Gold finish remains identical for every tier. Strong readable silhouettes at 80px, restrained bold forms. No black/silver tier rim, bronze recoloring, emoji, flat app icons, thin vector doodles, real people, watermarks, game logos or branded symbols.
The internal illustration grows through the specified stages; do not just swap a numeral or border color. Keep all objects fully inside the common outer contour.
Presentation: uniform matte charcoal #151918 backdrop, front-facing upright pins, same lighting and maximum pin height, generous spacing, every complete badge clearly visible. Add ONLY plain ivory numeric captions "50", "100", "1,000", "10,000" OUTSIDE and centered below their corresponding pins. No other lettering, no numerals on the actual jewelry. No case, background scenery, giant frames, glowing effects or missing tiers.

concepts.name: 이어지는 이야기
concepts.motif: Dimensional hard-enamel conversation bubbles in emerald, mint and ivory, with thick gold borders and no typography.
concepts.progression: 50: one bold sculpted bubble with a small gold star inside. 100: two connected bubbles. 1,000: three interlocking bubbles. 10,000: five bubbles forming a complete harmonious conversation rosette. These must look like physical jewelry, not emoji or flat app icons.
